cases.text: A learner shows a CV and points to a true task.
cases.judgement: Record what the CV and explanation actually show.
cases.next_step: Link the page or file; note the response mode and support.

cases.judgement: Record not yet for that evidence.
cases.next_step: Name the gap and plan a supported follow-up.

cases.text: A learner answers using a usual communication aid.
cases.judgement: The response may still be the learner’s own.
cases.next_step: Record content and support; do not judge speed or eye contact.

cases.text: An adult supplies the reason in an interview answer.
cases.judgement: The reason is prompted, not independently demonstrated.
cases.next_step: Record the prompt and the later response separately.

cases.text: A learner changes an answer after feedback.
cases.judgement: The later response shows a response to feedback.
cases.next_step: Keep the first response and the change; do not overwrite the first.

cases.text: The index is complete but no work can be opened.
cases.next_step: Record the access gap and arrange a check; do not infer attainment.

CAREERS-LAUNCH-A2-W07 · Year A · Week beginning 14 December 2026
Term theme: Identity & Belonging
Staff brief: 0 minutes.
Teacher: Use fictional role briefs and learner IDs. No real names, contacts, addresses, accounts, passwords or referee details. No calls, emails or applications are sent. Offer speech, pointing, writing, scribing or the learner’s usual communication aid. No forced pair work, public performance or personal disclosure. If a concern arises, listen privately and follow the local safeguarding route. This is the assessing lesson. Use the local teaching checks: CV shows relevant skills with a true example; application addresses the fictional role and is clear enough to follow; interview answer gives a relevant example or explains a sensible help request. For each, record shown independently, shown with support or not yet, alongside evidence and the precise support. These are teaching judgements, not awarding-body criteria or a qualification completion decision. Do not assess eye contact, accent, speaking speed or confidence. Preserve initial evidence before feedback.
Support: read, scribe exact words or use the usual aid; record all prompts. Do not supply the assessed reason.
Evidence: An individual Week 7 assessment record linked to the actual CV, application and portfolio, a short mock-interview exchange with initial answers and prompts, a distinct feedback response, observed support, missing evidence, teacher judgement and a learner-agreed next step.
